summary: Retain incarnation-bound launch contracts and expose prompt and binary drift

replay.detail: Existing start receipts remain readable; receipts without launch contracts report unknown drift.

schema.detail: Registers the optional launch_contract object on system-local runtime action receipts, changing registry identity. No storage migration or checkpoint version change.

rules.detail: No rollout, restart, checkpoint or fleet coordination policy changes.

compatibility.detail: Agent detail JSON gains an optional live owner-local launch_contract diagnostic using runtime/account preparation. Running identity captures installed render files, not changed copy sources. Clients preserve it; roster snapshots are unchanged. Publication never updates running identity.

downtime.detail: No additional interruption; existing processes retain unknown identity until replaced.

manual.detail: Inspect launch_contract with agents show --json on the owning daemon.

recovery.detail: Older binaries ignore optional receipt and response fields; no migration to reverse.
